subject: [PATCH v4 2/3] fs/proc/task_mmu: don't read young/dirty from a non-present PMD in smaps

2026-11-25.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the Linux kernel's /proc/PID/smaps functionality where it incorrectly reads young and dirty bits from non-present PMDs (Page Map Entries). The issue occurs because these bits are used to encode entry information rather than accessed/dirty state, leading to incorrect accounting. The patch ensures that these bits are only read when the PMD is present, preventing incorrect results on x86_64 systems where the entry's offset overlaps with _PAGE_SAVED_DIRTY. This fix addresses a problem introduced in commit c94b6923fa0a and has been reviewed by multiple developers.
